shortDescription: India's markets regulator said on Tuesday that four Adani companies including the flagship firm Adani Enterprises NSE:ADANIENT and one former group firm, have paid a total of 15.1 million rupees ($157,966.31) to settle proceedings over alleged disclosure violations.($1 = 95.5900 Indian rupees)
